title: Poor stitching on a cute oven mitt.
text: Poor stitching on a cute oven mitt.. I didn't have any problems with the color, as others have mentioned (yes, it's more "salmon"-y than a true pink, but I'm fine with that). And the size is fantastic. Problem is, the stitching is already coming apart, and I just took it out of the package! It's cute enough that I'll keep it and hope the rest of the construction is sturdy enough to last for a while.
